title: yummy yellow-glazed Indian beans Paella
description: Buttery, chewy, kid-friendly Indian (Goan) dish featuring beans, lacquer-glaze, vegan-friendly, served in a Paella pan.

ingredients.name: yellow moong dal
ingredients.notes: Split yellow mung beans, rinsed and drained.

ingredients.name: lacquer glaze (maple syrup and turmeric mixed)

instructions: Heat oil in a large Paella pan over medium heat.
Add onion, ginger, and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is translucent, about 8 minutes.
Add curry leaves and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add red kidney beans, moong dal, tamarind paste, turmeric, cumin, and salt; stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Stir in the lacquer glaze and cook for another 5 minutes, until the beans are well coated.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with a sprinkle of turmeric powder, if desired.
Serve with steamed basmati rice or roti for a complete meal.
If using lacquer glaze made with maple syrup, reduce the amount to 1 tablespoon, as it can be quite sweet.
